The plant garden has become an important part of daily life. Little by little, things began to change. Nina is saving money to buy a ticket to Rome. Also, her artistic talent showed in every school project.
At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. There are always more possibilities than we expect. On Monday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. Frogs sing loudly after the rain.

Nina believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. People around Nina often share different ideas about the river bank. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Birds sing on the highest branch.
Nina plans to study history harder this term. Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Nina thanked Ben for the honest advice. Buffalo cross the river at dawn.
Nina's dream job is to be a cook. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
